issues.message: Missing graph nodes for 21 files from scan inventory: .gitattributes, .gitmodules, recipes (git submodule entry), .github/CODEOWNERS, .github/config.yml, .github/issue_label_bot.yaml, .github/release.yml, .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md, .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/app_bug_report.yml, .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/app_feature_request.yml, .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/config.yml, .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/recipe_bug_report.yml, .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/recipe_request.yml, .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/something_else_open_issue.yml, .github/workflows/builds.yml, .github/workflows/codespell.yml, .github/workflows/homebrew-cask-updates.yml, .github/workflows/reddit.yml, .github/workflows/tag-repos.yml, .github/workflows/winget-bucket-update.yml

Critical main entry-point files have generic summaries instead of descriptive ones: src/app.tsx (Renderer entry point, renders React app with stores/routes) has 'Source file: src/app.tsx'; src/stores/index.ts (initializes all MobX stores) has 'Source file: src/stores/index.ts'; src/actions/index.ts (aggregates all action definitions) has 'Source file: src/actions/index.ts'
src/index.ts (Electron main process entry, 941 lines) has undersized summary 'Exports appEvents.' — should describe that it manages app lifecycle, window creation, IPC, auto-updates, and tray
src/stores/index.ts has no tags indicating its role as the store aggregator/orchestrator — missing 'mobx', 'has-exports', 'has-functions' tags

Root config files have overly generic summaries — 'Source file: X' instead of describing their purpose (e.g. .all-contributorsrc, .codespellrc, .dockerignore, .eslintignore, .prettierrc.js, jest.config.js, commitlint.config.js)

Imported-by relationships missing from graph edges. The import map shows reverse imports exist (e.g. src/api/AppApi.ts is imported by src/api/index.ts, src/api/FeaturesApi.ts is imported by src/api/index.ts) but the edges section only captures forward imports, creating false 'orphan' appearances. No reverse-direction edges exist in the 991 edge set.

Source code files in src/ with zero edges (no imports, not imported): src/@types/ferdium.types.ts, src/@types/legacy-types.ts, src/prop-types.ts, src/webview/zoom.ts, src/electron/exception.ts, src/helpers/favicon-helpers.ts — these should at minimum be used by or import something in the codebase

Incorrect fileCategory in scan for assets: branding/*.afphoto/.xcf/.psd files are assets, not 'code'. Similarly build-helpers/images/* are binary assets, not code files. Graph correctly types them as 'file' but tags are inconsistent.
Tag 'unknown' used liberally (e.g. .all-contributorsrc, .codespellrc, .dockerignore, .eslintignore, .npmrc, .nvmrc). Config dotfiles could have tags like 'config', 'dotfile', 'build-config' etc.

Edge weights are all 1 (unweighted). For files with multiple import relationships (e.g., src/index.ts imports ~20 files), edges have weight=1 rather than reflecting dependency frequency or importance.

Size line counts differ between scan and graph for many files (e.g., .all-contributorsrc: scan=3087, graph=3086; .codespellrc: scan=10, graph=9; .dockerignore: scan=33, graph=32; .eslintignore: scan=35, graph=34). Differences of 1-2 lines likely from trailing newline handling.
Type assignment for all .md files is consistent — all typed as 'document' in the graph.
Test files present in graph (6 nodes) match scan inventory. Good coverage.
i18n locale JSON files (58 locales) consistently typed as 'config' in both scan and graph. Good.

recommendations: Add 21 missing graph nodes for GitHub workflow/config files (.github/*, .gitattributes, .gitmodules, recipes submodule entry) — these are valid project files that should be represented even if they lack import relationships
Improve generic summaries on root entry points: src/app.tsx, src/stores/index.ts, src/index.ts, src/actions/index.ts — describe their actual architectural role rather than just restating the filename

Add reverse-direction edges ('imported-by' type) to complement the existing forward 'imports' edges, so that dependency analysis is bidirectional and files appear connected even when they don't import anything themselves

Investigate 6 src/ source files with zero edges: src/@types/ferdium.types.ts, src/@types/legacy-types.ts, src/prop-types.ts, src/webview/zoom.ts, src/electron/exception.ts, src/helpers/favicon-helpers.ts — determine if genuinely unused or if import detection missed their references

Add descriptive tags to config dotfiles (.all-contributorsrc, .codespellrc, .dockerignore, .eslintignore, .npmrc, .nvmrc) instead of generic 'unknown' tag — use tags like 'config', 'dotfile', 'build-config', 'lint'
Reconcile the 1-2 line size discrepancies between scan and graph values by using a consistent line counting method
Tag src/stores/index.ts with 'mobx', 'has-functions', 'has-exports', and 'store-aggregator' to reflect its role as the store initialization hub
Add SCSS/CSS style import edges where TypeScript/TSX components import .scss styles for a more complete dependency picture
